''For a summary of all translated versions of The Wheel of Time see [[The Wheel of Time translations]].''

The Wheel of Time translates to ''Das Rad der Zeit'' in German. The books were translated into German and published first by Heyne Verlag, divided into volumes smaller than the original books, and then re-published by Piper-Verlag in editions that correspond to the English originals.<ref>[http://translate.google.com/translate?hl=en&sl=auto&tl=en&u=http%3A%2F%2Fde.wikipedia.org%2Fwiki%2FDas_Rad_der_Zeit Google Translate for de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Das_Rad_der_Zeit]</ref>

===Piper First and Second Editions===
After Crossroads of Twilight, Piper published the remainder of the books and New Spring. The covers are mostly the same as the Hayne editions. There are only minor differences between the early Piper editions, namely the arch design with the artwork in the centre or no arch and the name of the book on a white horizontal band the location and size of which varies book to book. 

Note that New Spring is numbered 29 in the sequence of this books.

===Heyne Editions===
Heyne is the original publisher of the series in German. They published the books up until Crossroads of Twilight, not including New Spring. Some of the books have two or more editions under Heyne, with the newer cover artwork being later used by Piper.The gallery shows a mix of cover styles with differences between editions marked as alt. They come in four variants:

*The original 1993 versions of the first 3 German volumes.
*Framed artwork with pastel background. Volumes not numbered on front cover. Darker color Heyne logo in top left.
*Artwork without frame. Volumes numbered on front cover. Darker color Heyne logo in top left.
*Artwork without frame. Volumes numbered on front cover. New white text Hayne logo in top left.

Heyne also published a single-volume  version of The Eye of the World and [[The World of Robert Jordan's The Wheel of Time]] in hardback and paperback.
